text: The algorithm has identified features that are typical of a lesion in the sellar region, but it cannot reliably separate this possibility from another class that may share a comparable appearance on a routine brain MRI. Pituitary tumours are strongly anchored to a characteristic anatomical site, which gives a convolutional network a clear positional cue, yet the model evaluates only the visual characteristics of the scan and does not assess hormonal activity or optic-chiasm involvement that are central to pituitary management [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. Because the distinction between a pituitary lesion and other nearby pathologies can hinge on endocrine function and visual-field impact, the system's output should be regarded as a starting point for further clinical assessment rather than a definitive classification. It would be appropriate to discuss with a qualified professional the need for a dedicated pituitary-protocol MRI, comprehensive endocrine testing, formal visual-field assessment and multidisciplinary review by endocrinology, neurosurgery and ophthalmology [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Prompt evaluation is advised if any sudden headache, visual change or signs of adrenal insufficiency arise [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
